content.text:
I found the red ball and parked the robot about 0.3 m in front of it, roughly facing it, then called rest. The ball sits on the floor between the wheels of an office chair, slightly to the robot's left.

The route was not direct. The first approach ran into a black equipment case, and a later walk stopped at the chair base. The robot took a loop around both and stopped short of the chair base because getting closer would have meant walking into it.
